collection.title: Skoda Fabia Estate 2013 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Skoda Fabia Estate 2013 to 2014 requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Fabia which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
